newsitem.title: UK: UK's IMRO to drop investigation into Jupiter.
newsitem.headline: UK's IMRO to drop investigation into Jupiter.

text.p: UK investment regulator IMRO said it has concluded investigations into Jupiter Asset Management prompted by allegations in the London Financial News newspaper and will be taking no discipinary action.

A statement from Jupiter said it welcomed the decision by the Investment Management Regulatory Organisation, which follows separate exhaustive investigations made on behalf of the trustees of several of the Water Pension Schemes.
"Following those earlier investigations, the trustees of these schemes unanimously decide to confirm their arrangement with Jupiter Asset Management," the statement said.
JAM chairman John Duffield said he was delighted with the outcome and would be pursuing JAM's libel case against the newspaper "with the utmost vigour".
